book.name: Luku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Yesun mɑrubu
Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔ, tem yɛ̃ro Oɡusitu u woodɑ yɑrɑ bu tem bɑɑmɑ kpuron tɔmbu ɡɑri.
Gɑri ɡɑri ɡbiikɑɑ ye, bɑ ye kuɑwɑ Kirinusi Sirin tem yɛ̃ron wɑɑti.
Mɑ bɑɑwure u dɑ win wuuɔ bu kɑ nùn tireru doke.
Yosɛfu u mɑɑ seewɑ Gɑlilen wuu ɡɑɡun di ɡe bɑ rɑ soku Nɑsɑrɛti, u dɑ Yudeɑn temɔ sere Dɑfidin wuuɔ ɡe bɑ rɑ nɛɛ Bɛtelehɛmu yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ Dɑfidin sikɑdobu,
kpɑ bu kɑ bu tireru doke, wi kɑ win kurɔ kɛ̃ɛro Mɑɑri. Mɑɑri wi, u ɡurɑ mɔ.
Ye bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, win sɑnɑm yibɑ ye u koo kɑ mɑ.
Mɑ u win bii ɡbiikoo mɑrɑ tɔn durɔ, mɑ u nùn sɛ̃kɑtiɑ tɛ̃kusi u nùn kpĩ yɑ̃ɑnun yɑkɑsu wɔllɔ, yèn sɔ̃ bɑ ǹ ɑyeru wɑ sɔbun sɔbiɑ yerɔ.
Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo
u yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobu kure
N deemɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobɑ wɑ̃ɑ berɑ mi yɑkɑsɔ, bɑ ben yɑ̃ɑnu kɔ̃su wɔ̃kuru.
Yerɑ Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo u bu kure mɑ Gusunɔn yiikon ɡirimɑ yɑ bu burure yɑ kɑ sikerenɑ mɑ bɛrum bu mwɑ ɡem ɡem.
Mɑ ɡɔrɑdo u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ku nɑndɑ domi nɑ kɑ bɛɛ Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ nɑɑwɑwɑ ye yɑ koo tɔmbu kpuro nuku doo bɑkɑbu wɛ̃.
Gisɔ Dɑfidin wuuɔ bɑ bɛɛ Fɑɑbɑ kowo mɑruɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Kirisi Yinni.
Wee, nɡe mɛ i ko kɑ nùn tubu, i ko bii wɛ̃ɛru wɑ bɑ sɛ̃kɑtiɑ tɛ̃kusi, u kpĩ yɑ̃ɑnun yɑkɑsu wɔllɔ.
Suɑru sɔɔ wɔllun tɑbu kowobu dɑbi dɑbiru bɑ kurɑmɑ ɡɔrɑdo win bɔkuɔ bɑ Gusunɔ siɑrɑmɔ bɑ ɡerumɔ,

content.text: Bɔri yɛndɑ n wɑ̃ɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ be bɑ Gusunɔn nukuru dorɑsiɑmɔn suunu sɔɔ.

content: Yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobɑ dɔɔ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ wɔllun ɡɔrɑdo be, bɑ bu doonɑri bɑ wurɑ Gusunɔ wɔllɔ, yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro be, bɑ ɡerunɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, su dɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ su wɑ ye yɑ koorɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u sun sɔ̃ɔsi.
Bɑ dɑ kɑ sɛndɑru mɑ bɑ Mɑɑri kɑ Yosɛfu wɑ kɑ bii wɛ̃ɛ te, tɑ kpĩ yɑ̃ɑnun yɑkɑsu wɔllɔ.
Ye bɑ nùn wɑ bɑ kpɑ bɑ sɑɑrɑ ye ɡɔrɑdo wi, u rɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bii win wɔllɔ.
Mɑ be kpuro be bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ bɑ biti soorɑ kɑ ye yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Adɑmɑ Mɑɑri u ɡɑri yi kpuro doke ɡɔ̃ruɔ u yi lɑsɑbu mɔ̀.
Mɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ bɑ Gusunɔ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ, bɑ nùn siɑrɑmɔ yɑbu ye kpuron sɔ̃ ye bɑ nuɑ kɑ ye bɑ wɑ, nɡe mɛ ɡɔrɑdo wi, u rɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Bɑ Yesu yĩsiru kɑ̃
Ye sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑ yɑ yibɑ bɑ bii wi bɑnɡo kuɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Yesu, yĩsi te Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo u nùn kɑ̃ bɑ sere win ɡurɑ suɑ.
Bɑ Yesu Gusunɔ tusiɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ

Amɛniwɑ bɑ yoruɑ Yinnin woodɑ sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, “Bii tɔn durɔ ɡbiikoo bɑɑwure wi bɑ mɑrɑ, bɑ koo nùn wunɑwɑ nɛnɛm Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃.” Yen sɔ̃nɑ ye sɑnɑm yibɑ bu kɑ tii sɑ̃rɑsiɑ nɡe mɛ Mɔwisin woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ, Mɑɑri kɑ Yosɛfu bɑ kɑ bii wi dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bu nùn Yinni tusiɑ,
kpɑ bu kɑ yɑ̃kuru ko nɡe mɛ bɑ ɡeruɑ Yinnin woodɑ sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, “Kpɑrukonu yiru, ǹ kun mɛ totobɛrɛ binu yiru.”
Durɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, win yĩsirɑ Simɛɔ. Durɔ wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡeeɡii wi u Gusunɔn bɛɛrɛ yɛ̃. U wi u koo Isirelibɑn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ swɑɑ dɑki mɑ Hunde Dɛɛro nùn wɑ̃ɑsi.
Hunde Dɛɛro wi, u mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ u koo Kirisi, wi Yinni u ɡɔsɑ wɑ u sere ɡbi.
U dɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kɑ Hunde Dɛɛron kpɑrɑbu. Ye Yesun dusibɑ kɑ nùn duɑ bu nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ,
Simɛɔ u nùn mwɑ win nɔmɑɔ mɑ u Gusunɔ sɑɑbu kuɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yinni, tɛ̃ kɑɑ de nɛ wunɛn sɔm kowo, n hɑnduniɑ deri kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ
Domi nɛn nɔni yi wunɛn fɑɑbɑ wɑ
ye ɑ sɔɔru kuɑ bwesenu kpuron wuswɑɑɔ.
Yeyɑ yɑm bururɑm mɛ mu koo tɔn tukobu wunɛn swɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsi.
Mu koo mɑɑ wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ bɛɛrɛ doke.

content: Simɛɔ u Gusunɔn ɡɑri ɡeruɑ
Ye bɑ ɡeruɑ bii win sɔ̃ yɑ win bɑɑ kɑ win mɛro biti kuɑ.

Simɛɔ u bu domɑru kuɑ mɑ u Mɑɑri, bii win mɛro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ bii wini ɡɔsɑ bɑ yi u kɑ tɔn dɑbiru wɔrumɑsiɑ Isirelibɑ sɔɔ, kpɑ u tɔn dɑbinu seesiɑ. U koo mɑɑ ko yĩreru Gusunɔn min di te tɔmbɑ kun wurɑmɔ
kpɑ dɑbirun ɡɔ̃run bwisikunu nu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ. Wunɛn tii, nuku sɑnkirɑnu nu koo nun sɔku ɡɔ̃ruɔ nɡe tɑkobi.
Anɑ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ tɔn kurɔ
Gusunɔn sɔmɔ tɔn kurɔ ɡoo mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ, win yĩsirɑ Anɑ, Fɑnuɛlin bii Asɛɛn bweseru sɔɔ. U tɔkɔru kuɑ ɡem ɡem. U rɑɑ sinɑ kɑ win durɔ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru sɑɑ win wɔndiɑrun di.
Mɑ u ɡɔminiru sinɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɛnɛ kɑ nnɛ. U ku rɑ kpe sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, u rɑ n Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑmɔ bururu kɑ yokɑ kɑ nɔɔ bɔkuru kɑ kɑnɑru.
U besirɑmɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, u Gusunɔ sɑɑbu mɔ̀, mɑ u bii win ɡɑri tɔmbu kpuro sɔ̃ɔmɔ be bɑ mɑrɑ Gusunɔ u Yerusɑlɛmu yɑkiɑ.
Ben wurɑmɑru Nɑsɑrɛtiɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ bɑɑyere kuɑ bɑ kpɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑ, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ Nɑsɑrɛti ben wuuɔ Gɑlilen temɔ.
Mɑ bii wi, u kpɛ̃ɑmɔ mɑ u dɑm sosimɔ mɑ bwisi ɡee yibɑ wi sɔɔ. Gusunɔn durom mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi.
Yesu dɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ win birun sɑɑ
Wɔ̃ɔ bɑɑɡere Yesun dusibu bɑ rɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru dewɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ yiru mɔ bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te dɑ nɡe mɛ ben komɑru.
Ye tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ ten sɑnɑm kpɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ wiɔ, bii wi, Yesu u sinɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, win dusibɑ kun yɛ̃.
Bɑ tɑmɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ u wɑ̃ɑwɑ ben wuuru sɔɔ. Ye bɑ sĩɑ tɔ̃ɔ ɡiriru bɑ nùn kɑsu ben dusibu kɑ ben bɔrɔbɑ sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ nùn wɑ mɑ bɑ ɡɔsirɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bɑ nùn kɑsu.
Yen sɔ̃ɔ itɑse bɑ nùn wɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ u sɔ̃ woodɑ yɛ̃robun suunu sɔɔ u bu swɑɑ dɑki u mɑɑ bu ɡɑri bikiɑmɔ.
Be bɑ nùn swɑɑ dɑki kpuro bɑ biti kuɑ win bwisi kɑ win ɡɑri wisibun sɔ̃.
Sɑnɑm mɛ win dusibɑ nùn wɑ biti yɑ bu mwɑ mɑ win mɛro u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn bii ɑmɔnɑ ɑ kɑ sun kuɑ mɛ. Nɛ kɑ wunɛn bɑɑ wee, sɑ nun kɑsu kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu.
Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n kuɑ i kɑ mɑn kɑsu. I ǹ yɛ̃ mɑ nɑ ǹ kon ko nɑ kun nɛn bɑɑbɑn wunɑnɔsu kue?
Adɑmɑ ɡɑri yi u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ mi, yi ǹ bu yeeri.
U kɑ bu sĩɑ Nɑsɑrɛtiɔ mɑ u bu mɛm nɔɔwɑ. Win mɛro u ɡɑri yi kpuro beruɑ win ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Mɑ Yesu u kpɛ̃ɑmɔ bwisi sɔɔ kɑ wɑsi sɔɔ, mɑ Gusunɔ u kɑ nùn nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛrɑ, mɑ u sɑ̃ɑ tɔn ɡeo tɔmbu sɔɔ.
